title: Tidewater
summary: A banking app where money moves like water: every transfer shows where it came from and where it went.

body.html:
Kestrel's customers trusted the bank and distrusted the app. Transfers vanished into a spinner and reappeared as a line item, and support calls spiked every payday.

What we changed

We designed a motion system around one idea: money never teleports. A transfer leaves your balance, travels, and lands: and the interface shows each step at the speed it actually happens.

The same three easing curves now run through the whole app, from pull-to-refresh to the card freeze switch.
